domain.description: The registrable domain the server asked about.

available.description: false when the registry could not be asked. Then registered is null, and only reason and retry_after_seconds follow. It does not tell whether the domain is free to register.

registered.description: true when the answer holds the registration. null when available is false. A domain that is not registered is an error, so it is never false.

reason.description: Present only when available is false. It is no_registry_server when no registry server is known for the TLD, or quota_exhausted when the server reached its request limit for the registry server.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before the server sends that request again. Present only when available is false. null unless reason is quota_exhausted.

rdap_server.description: It is the base URL of the RDAP server that was asked. null when a WHOIS server was asked.

whois_server.description: It is the host of the WHOIS server that was asked. null when an RDAP server was asked.

registrar_iana_id.description: null when the registration names none.

created_at.description: An RDAP date as the server wrote it. A WHOIS date is YYYY-MM-DD or a UTC time. null when none can be read.

status.description: It lists the first 16 status values.

status_count.description: It counts every status value, past the first 16 too.

name_servers.description: It lists the first 16 name servers.

name_server_count.description: It counts every name server, past the first 16 too.

dnssec_signed.description: Whether the delegation is signed with DNSSEC. null when the answer does not say.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
